channel.title: Extensions on notd
channel.description: Recent content in Extensions on notd

item.title: Kanban Board
item.description:
The kanban board shows every task in your notes as a card, in one column per task state. Dragging a card to another column rewrites the keyword at the start of the note (for example TODO to DOING), exactly as if you had edited the note.

Cards come from notes, so there is nothing to keep in sync: write a task anywhere and it is on the board. A card shows the note’s text as written, properties included.

item.title: Pomodoro Timer
item.description:
The Pomodoro timer alternates work sessions and breaks. When a session ends, it is logged as a note, so your notes show what you spent the day on and queries can add it up.

It is on by default; open it with the clock icon in the right sidebar. Leave the tab open while the timer runs.

item.title: Attachment Dashboard
item.description:
Files you attach to notes (paste or drop them onto a note, or use Upload attachment in the note menu) are shown below the note they belong to. The attachment dashboard lists all of them in one place.

It is on by default; open it with the paperclip icon in the right sidebar.

item.title: Zen Writer
item.description:
The Zen writer opens one note in a full-screen editor with nothing else on the screen: good for longer pieces of writing that would feel cramped in the outline.

Turning it on

Add zen to ACTIVE_EXTENSIONS in config.local.php (see Turning extensions on and off). It then appears in the note menu.

item.title: Math Notepad
item.description:
The math notepad turns a note into a small calculation sheet. Write one calculation per line on the left; the result of every line appears on the right as you type. Saving keeps the calculation in the note, so it is there to rework later.

Turning it on

Add math_notepad to ACTIVE_EXTENSIONS in config.local.php (see Turning extensions on and off). It then appears in the note menu.

item.title: Excalidraw
item.description:
Excalidraw is a whiteboard for quick, hand-drawn-looking diagrams. This extension opens it for a note and saves the drawing to that note.

It needs an internet connection. Unlike the rest of notd, Excalidraw is not bundled: it is loaded from a CDN (esm.sh) when the editor opens.

Turning it on

Add excalidraw_editor to ACTIVE_EXTENSIONS in config.local.php (see Turning extensions on and off). It then appears in the note menu. It also gets an icon in the right sidebar, but a drawing can only be saved when Excalidraw was opened from a note.

item.title: RSS Handler
item.description:
The RSS handler reads RSS and Atom feeds and adds every item it has not seen before as a note. It is a command-line script, so it runs on the machine where notd runs and can be scheduled to keep feeds up to date.

Setting it up

List your feeds in extensions/rss_handler/config.json:

{
 "api_url": "http://localhost:8000/api",
 "default_page_name_for_rss": "Inbox/rss",
 "feeds": [
 "https://example.com/feed.xml",
 { "url": "https://example.org/feed", "page_name": "<today>/rss" },
 { "url": "https://example.net/news.rss", "page_name": "News" }
 ]
}
Key Meaning
api_url notd’s address followed by /api.
default_page_name_for_rss Page for feeds that do not name one.
feeds A feed URL, or {"url": ..., "page_name": ...} to send that feed to its own page. <today> in a page name becomes the date, so <today>/rss collects each day’s items under the journal page.

item.title: Mail Handler
item.description: The mail handler reads one e-mail message (in the raw .eml format mail programs and servers use) and adds it as a note to today’s journal page. It is experimental: it handles plain-text messages. It does not decode MIME, so for HTML messages, messages with attachments, or encoded text and subjects, the note gets the message body as it was sent, encoding and all.

item.title: Espanso: Clipboard to Journal
item.description:
Espanso is a free text expander for Windows, macOS and Linux: you type a short trigger and it replaces it, in any program. notd comes with an Espanso configuration that turns copied text into a note:

  1. Copy some text (a quote, a link, an idea from a chat).
  2. Type ;notd anywhere you can type.
  3. The text is added as a new note at the end of today’s journal page, with {source::espanso}. The ;notd you typed disappears.

Nothing is typed when it works. When the clipboard is empty or notd cannot be reached, a short message such as [notd: could not save to http://localhost:8000] is typed where you are instead, so a failure never goes unnoticed.

item.title: Writing an Extension
item.description:
An extension is a folder in extensions/ with two files:

  • config.json, with at least {"featherIcon": "<icon name>"}: the sidebar icon, a name from Feather. Put the extension’s own settings next to it.
  • index.php, the page that opens when the icon is clicked. It can be a complete page, or include one, as the default extensions do (<?php require __DIR__ . '/kanban.php';).

Add the folder name to ACTIVE_EXTENSIONS in config.local.php and reload notd: the icon appears in the right sidebar.
